summary: Orientation editing for students with functionalities to save and update orientation details, including agency, site, onsite location, and comments. Includes validation and session management.
purpose: To manage and edit student orientation information within the HSPnet enrollment system.

workflows.name: Editing and Saving Orientation Information
steps: Retrieve agency and site details from UI controls.
Check if orientation details are marked as dirty.
Invoke controller to add or update orientation details based on conditions.
Redirect or reload based on outcomes.

business_rules: Use of providerTypeCodeID to differentiate provider types
validations: Textarea max length for comments set to 1000 characters
GridView row command checks for data and update operation status
conditions: Check if orientationID is 0 for a new record
Check for session validity before operations
system_behavior: Disable calendar controls for readonly access
exceptions: Redirect only if no error messages are present
